text:
alex: quick note  noticed a weird spike in quota burn for tenants on the canary path after enabling the route-header shim in the clients (go/ts/py). console is showing a cluster of tenants with +25-40% apparent consumption.

maria: ah. Which header mapping? We moved from `X-Route` -> `x-rd-route` with a structured payload last week.

alex: right. The clients now send `x-rd-route: {"id":"tenant-...","pref":"low"}`. runtime/meter-proxy emits the original `route_id` in logs, but the ingest pipeline picks up the raw header and canonicalizes into a hash. so console groups by hashed key while quota ledger looks up raw id.

jamal: that mismatch would surface as an apparent extra burn. Is this limited to canary? what's the rollout percentage?

alex: canary at 10% traffic for new clients, but the tenant mix is skewed so a few big customers are in the canary cohort.

rachel: i can corroborate in the dashboard: the affected tenants show two route keys in the last 6h. one matches their org id, one is hash:*.

infra-bot: deploy/ingest-canonicalizer v3.2 -> canary (10%) triggered by @maria at 2026-04-02T14:10:05Z :rocket:

maria: mitigation proposal: 1) revert clients to opt-in shim (stop default) 2) add a console reconciler to join hashed/unhashed for the canary window 3) add a telemetry event in SDKs when a rewrite occurs so we can join events end-to-end.

nora: prefer short-term: (2) + (3). Reverting defaults in all languages is disruptive to customers; but we can make the opt-in toggle and flip it in the next patch. Also we should gate client default behind a server-side rollout flag.

jamal: for go and ts clients, toggle is easy. i can prepare a patch to make the shim opt-in and wire a feature flag check. branch `go-ts/shim-optin-rollout`. i'll open PR with a canary test.

rachel: console-side: i'll add a reconciliation job that consumes the mapping between original header -> hash for the canary window. we can surface a "merged" view and keep the raw hashed view for debugging. show an annotation on tenant pages.

alex: i'll export the mapping from ingress logs (route_id -> hashed_key) and drop as csv into infra S3.

maria: add metrics: 1) percent of requests where meter-proxy route != ingest route 2) count of tenants with dual keys 3) divergence ratio (console vs ledger). We'll require divergence < 3% for 48h before re-enabling default.

jamal: note for SDK teams: we already shipped py and ts with default shim. we need a small patch release for py/ts and minor for go. plan: ship opt-in toggle, add telemetry opt-in flag (so we can emit rewrite events only for debug tenants), and update migration docs.

nora: docs should include a clear troubleshooting section: how to detect double-counting, curl examples, and how to opt-in to shim if desired. also include the server-side feature flag name and the console annotation behavior.

alex: example curl to reproduce (client rewrite emulation):

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Route-ID: tenant-900" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'

// clients rewrite to: `x-rd-route: {"id":"tenant-900","pref":"low"}` on the wire

maria: jamal, can you include a small unit/integration smoke for the patch that asserts meter-proxy and ingest route keys match when rewrite telemetry is on? that'll make verification faster.

jamal: yep adding tests. will also include a test harness that fakes header -> hash mapping so console changes can be validated in staging. PR link when ready.

infra-bot: PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/clients/pull/1301 by @jamal :white_check_mark:

rachel: timeline: console reconciler proto in 24h, reconciliation job in prod canary in 48h. dashboard tile + tenant annotation in 72h.

nora: long-term we should standardize canonicalization at the ingest layer and have clients opt to send canonical id (string) or structured route object, but not both. that avoids the need for reconciliation. add to roadmap.

alex: agreed. for now: short-term opt-in + console merge + telemetry event. action items: jamal -> cut client opt-in patch, maria -> coordinate ingest canonicalizer change plan, rachel -> console recon job + dashboard, alex -> mapping csv upload. target: stop default divergence within 48h.

maria: i'll also add a rollout UX change in the console to surface a recommended default state per tenant (suggest opt-out for sensitive tenants until canonicalizer is stable).

jamal: PR linked here when created. ping me if you want me to flip the feature flag for a specific tenant to test.

alex: thanks team. keep comms tight, and avoid customer emails until we have the reconciled numbers. :lock:
